roles.label: Action
roles.summary: Runs from an AP or XAP action position.
roles.reference: Action behavior may continue, halt, call, replace, or return through the central interpreter.

roles.label: Encounter
roles.summary: Adds behavior to an encounter boundary.
roles.reference: Attach behavior to the encounter, a selected option or result, or the completion boundary.

roles.label: Spell
roles.summary: Validates, casts, applies, ticks, or expires a scenario spell.
roles.reference: Validation is pure; cast and effect hooks route combat and presentation through typed ports. An applied effect may declare a bounded duration and round, movement, or scenario-time interval; the runtime then dispatches tick and expiration hooks from serializable effect state.

roles.label: Item
roles.summary: Adds behavior to an item definition or instance boundary.
roles.reference: Field and combat use may yield. Equipment, attack, defense, and passive hooks are pure; they may reject an equipment transition or return bounded numeric modifiers. Item-instance state remains attached to the stable item instance rather than a copied dictionary.

roles.label: Monster AI
roles.summary: Chooses one validated action from an immutable combat snapshot.
roles.reference: AI cannot mutate combat directly or retain live Godot objects.

roles.label: Lifecycle
roles.summary: Observes stable campaign and gameplay lifecycle boundaries.
roles.reference: Lifecycle hooks receive a typed event and execute in deterministic binding order.

roles.label: Rule Modifier
roles.summary: Returns a bounded modifier for a named gameplay calculation.
roles.reference: Modifiers run after the selected gameplay profile and built-in providers, then pass through domain clamping.

roles.label: Helper
roles.summary: Provides reusable typed logic called by entry behavior or migrations.
roles.reference: Helpers cannot recurse and participate in the shared call-depth and execution budgets.
roles.example:
func has_deadline(day: int) -> bool:
    return day <= 3

operations.label: Read State
operations.summary: Reads a Classic quest flag or typed scenario-state value.
operations.reference: Use named state for new Remake behavior. Quest scope is the compatibility adapter for Classic flag IDs.

operations.label: Set State
operations.summary: Writes a Classic quest flag or typed scenario-state value.
operations.reference: The value must match the state definition for the selected scope.

operations.label: Deterministic Roll
operations.summary: Returns a deterministic integer from 1 through the supplied maximum.
operations.reference: The scenario RNG is serialized in the save and is the only random source available to Safe behavior.

operations.label: Current Location
operations.summary: Returns the party's current land or dungeon location.
operations.reference: The result is an immutable snapshot and cannot expose a map node.

operations.label: Current Time
operations.summary: Returns the scenario day and time.
operations.reference: Day is the campaign day used by Classic timed encounters.

operations.label: Teleport Party
operations.summary: Moves the party to a validated map location.
operations.reference: The normal map-transition lifecycle, exploration state, music, and timed-event checks still run.

operations.label: Change Map Tile
operations.summary: Changes a land or dungeon tile through the map runtime.
operations.reference: The mutation is stored in campaign runtime state and survives save/load.

operations.label: Advance Time
operations.summary: Advances or rewinds the campaign clock through the configured rules.
operations.reference: Timed encounters and condition progression run at the same boundaries as native time changes.

operations.label: Party Wealth
operations.summary: Returns total and pooled party wealth.
operations.reference: Gold includes the party members and pool so affordability matches Realmz payment behavior.

operations.label: Take Party Wealth
operations.summary: Atomically takes wealth if the party can afford it.
operations.reference: No wealth is removed when the complete requested payment cannot be made.

operations.label: Party Has Item
operations.summary: Tests scenario-stable item identity across the party.
operations.reference: Use Providence's item picker; authors should not normally enter the numeric ID.

operations.label: Give Treasure
operations.summary: Presents and awards an authored treasure record.
operations.reference: The normal loot interface and item-instance materialization are used.

operations.label: Party Members
operations.summary: Returns bounded immutable snapshots of the player party.
operations.reference: References in the snapshots remain stable for the current playthrough.

operations.label: Party Condition
operations.summary: Tests a named Classic-compatible party condition.
operations.reference: Providence presents condition names while the package retains the stable condition index.
operations.example: var healthy: bool = not await party_condition(diseased)

operations.label: Change Party Health
operations.summary: Heals or damages the party or the current character selection through the character rules.
operations.reference: Target mode may be party or selected; death and recovery lifecycle events use the normal character path.

operations.label: Give Experience
operations.summary: Awards experience under the active character rules.
operations.reference: Level progression and presentation stay owned by the character port.

operations.label: Show Text
operations.summary: Shows scenario text and waits for its normal presentation boundary.
operations.reference: Use a String record reference when the text is shared or styled.
operations.example: await show_text("The captain accepts your payment.")

operations.label: Request Choice
operations.summary: Shows a bounded choice and returns the selected zero-based option.
operations.reference: The pending choice and selected result are safe save boundaries.

operations.label: Show Picture
operations.summary: Shows a packaged scenario picture.
operations.reference: Providence supplies the picture picker and preview.

operations.label: Play Sound
operations.summary: Plays packaged or stock sound through the presentation service.
operations.reference: Wait behavior is explicit rather than encoded in the sign of an author-entered number.

operations.label: Start Encounter
operations.summary: Starts an authored encounter and returns its result.
operations.reference: Encounter continuation and result mutation remain in the central interpreter.
operations.example: var result: int = await start_encounter("simple", offer)

operations.label: Start Battle
operations.summary: Starts an authored battle through the normal combat lifecycle.
operations.reference: Battle terrain, monsters, rewards, macros, and continuation use the same runtime as Classic actions.

operations.label: Combat Snapshot
operations.summary: Returns a bounded immutable view of current combat.
operations.reference: Monster AI and rule behaviors cannot receive live combatant nodes.

operations.label: Apply Damage
operations.summary: Applies validated combat damage and returns the actual amount.
operations.reference: Resistance, death, animation, and effect events remain owned by combat.

operations.label: Apply Healing
operations.summary: Applies validated combat healing and returns the actual amount.
operations.reference: Healing cannot revive a target unless the behavior uses an explicit revival operation.

operations.label: Redraw Map
operations.summary: Clears temporary presentation and redraws the active map.
operations.reference: Use this after pictures or authored map changes when the map should become visible immediately.

operations.label: Set Action Point Chance
operations.summary: Changes an authored AP or XAP activation percentage.
operations.reference: The change is stored in campaign state and survives save and load.

operations.label: Set Camping Permission
operations.summary: Allows or prevents camping through the active map rules.
operations.reference: The HUD and rest controls update through the normal camping boundary.

operations.label: Set Map Darkness
operations.summary: Changes the authored darkness level for a land or dungeon map.
operations.reference: The map mutation is saved and the active view is refreshed when applicable.

operations.label: Give Player Map
operations.summary: Adds an authored map or note to the party.
operations.reference: Providence supplies a player-map picker; display optionally opens it immediately.

operations.label: Show Scrolling Text
operations.summary: Shows a packaged scrolling-text resource.
operations.reference: The operation waits until the player closes the scrolling-text presentation.

operations.label: Wait for Acknowledgement
operations.summary: Waits at an explicit player acknowledgement boundary.
operations.reference: Presentation rules may shorten authored waits while preserving the continuation boundary.

operations.label: Play Music
operations.summary: Plays a packaged track or a configured Remake music category.
operations.reference: A track name takes precedence; otherwise Remake resolves the selected music category.

operations.label: Drop All Party Items
operations.summary: Removes every carried party item and returns the number removed.
operations.reference: Item instances are removed through the inventory API so equipment and load stay consistent.

operations.label: Open Shop
operations.summary: Loads an authored shop and optionally opens it immediately.
operations.reference: Scenario item identities, saved shop mutations, and normal purchase rules remain active.

operations.label: Open Temple Services
operations.summary: Enables temple services at the supplied price percentage.
operations.reference: The active inventory and character rule providers still validate each service.

operations.label: Enable Banking
operations.summary: Enables the normal banking interface for the current location.
operations.reference: This grants access through Remake's existing money and storage UI.

operations.label: Clear Party Currency
operations.summary: Clears gold, gems, or jewelry from the party or selected characters.
operations.reference: Currency uses the friendly Providence selector; the stored value is the stable zero-based currency index.
operations.example: var removed: int = await inventory_clear_currency(0, false)

operations.label: Alter Party Items
operations.summary: Removes, recharges, or replaces matching scenario item instances.
operations.reference: Action is remove, charges, or replace; equipped items follow the normal unequip and validation path.

operations.label: Store or Restore Equipment
operations.summary: Captures party equipment or restores the previously captured set.
operations.reference: The storage snapshot is owned by the Inventory port and included in saves.

operations.label: Change Party Fatigue
operations.summary: Adds a signed amount to party fatigue through the active rules.
operations.reference: The result is clamped by the selected character and map-time providers.

operations.label: Party Has Ally
operations.summary: Tests whether the party currently has the selected authored monster as an ally.
operations.reference: The check uses the saved Classic monster identity rather than display-name guessing.

operations.label: Add Party Ally
operations.summary: Creates an authored monster as a persistent party ally.
operations.reference: The monster record and scenario-specific image identity are resolved from the active package.

operations.label: Remove Party Ally
operations.summary: Removes every matching authored ally from the party.
operations.reference: Selection state and the party HUD are updated with the ally list.

operations.label: Remove Experience
operations.summary: Removes experience from the party or current selected characters.
operations.reference: Experience never falls below the character progression floor.
operations.example: var removed: int = await character_remove_experience(100, true)

operations.label: Apply Character Condition
operations.summary: Applies or clears a Classic-compatible condition on party members.
operations.reference: Target mode is party, selected, or living; condition duration uses the normal condition clock.
operations.example: var affected: int = await character_condition("party", diseased, 8)

operations.label: Ask Player to Pick Characters
operations.summary: Opens the party picker and stores the resulting character selection.
operations.reference: Later selected-character operations consume this explicit saved selection.

operations.label: Check Character Ability
operations.summary: Picks one living character and performs an attribute or special-ability check.
operations.reference: Providence supplies named attributes and abilities while preserving the stable source index.
operations.example: var passed: bool = await character_ability_check("attribute", strength, 0)

operations.label: Level Selected Characters
operations.summary: Advances the currently selected characters through normal progression.
operations.reference: Classic or Samuel character providers still own the actual level-up calculations.

operations.label: Check Party Property
operations.summary: Tests party level, camp or boat state, selection, race, caste, or gender.
operations.reference: Providence presents selector-specific controls and hides fields that do not apply.

operations.label: Cast Authored Spell
operations.summary: Resolves an authored or stock spell against the party or selected characters.
operations.reference: Spell bindings, validation, effects, saves, and presentation run through the normal spell path.

operations.label: Combat Has Monster
operations.summary: Tests the active battle for a Classic monster-name identity.
operations.reference: The check does not confuse scenario-local images or duplicate display names.

operations.label: Destroy Combat Monsters
operations.summary: Removes matching monsters from the active battle.
operations.reference: The result is bounded by maximum and runs through normal combatant cleanup.

operations.label: Rout Combat Monsters
operations.summary: Forces matching monsters to surrender or flee under combat morale rules.
operations.reference: The selected gameplay profile may disable Classic morale behavior.

operations.label: Spawn Combat Monsters
operations.summary: Spawns authored monsters near the active combat actor.
operations.reference: Monster identity, scenario art, placement validation, and combat limits remain owned by Combat.

operations.label: Revive Combatants
operations.summary: Revives eligible defeated combatants through the Classic revival behavior.
operations.reference: The active combat snapshot determines eligible targets and placement.

operations.label: Set Priest Turning
operations.summary: Enables or disables priest turning for the current campaign state.
operations.reference: The state is saved and the normal combat presentation announces the change.

operations.label: End Battle
operations.summary: Ends the active battle with a validated outcome and reward mode.
operations.reference: Use won, lost, escaped, or aborted; normal battle cleanup and lifecycle hooks still run.

operations.label: Fumble Active Combatant
operations.summary: Makes the active combatant drop its current melee weapon when combat rules permit it.
operations.reference: Player weapons enter the bounded battle fumble queue; monster weapons are removed through the same combat cleanup path.
operations.example: var dropped: bool = await combat_fumble("The weapon slips free!")

operations.label: Change Combat Monsters
operations.summary: Changes the faction or scenario icon of matching allies or monsters in the active battle.
operations.reference: Target type is ally or monster. Providence supplies authored monster and icon pickers and Remake validates the bounded match count.

operations.label: Move Party by Offset
operations.summary: Moves the party relative to its current map position.
operations.reference: The destination uses the normal map transition and boundary validation path and is saved in campaign state.

operations.label: Face Party
operations.summary: Faces the party north, east, south, or west.
operations.reference: Providence presents the stable headings 1 through 4 as named directions and Remake redraws the active view.

operations.label: Set Map View Options
operations.summary: Changes compass visibility or access to the full overhead map.
operations.reference: Omitted options retain their current values; the chosen view state is included in saves.

operations.label: Change Land Appearance
operations.summary: Changes the tileset identity and optional darkness of an authored land level.
operations.reference: Only packaged land looks may be selected; tile projection and saved map overrides remain owned by Map.

operations.label: Configure Random Encounter Area
operations.summary: Changes the encounter chance and optional battle range for an authored random rectangle.
operations.reference: The original bounds and scheduling data are preserved unless separately authored, and the override survives save and load.

operations.label: Set Sailing State
operations.summary: Places the exploring party in or out of its campaign boat state.
operations.reference: The normal exploration icon and movement state are refreshed immediately.

operations.label: Move Party Back
operations.summary: Moves the party one tile opposite a supplied entry direction.
operations.reference: Providence presents the entry direction by name; a zero or invalid direction returns false without inventing movement.

operations.label: Change Selected Character Stat
operations.summary: Changes a supported stat on the currently selected characters.
operations.reference: Providence offers named choices for actions, movement, damage, spell points, health, defense, accuracy, resistance, hand-to-hand, and prestige.

operations.label: Select Characters by Identity
operations.summary: Replaces the current character selection using race, caste, gender, or authored identity groups.
operations.reference: Race and caste controls use the scenario's named rule tables while keeping stable numeric identity values.
operations.example: var selected: int = await character_select_identity("race", orc, true)

operations.label: Select Characters by Property
operations.summary: Replaces the current selection using movement, items, equipment, conditions, saves, or other bounded character properties.
operations.reference: Providence changes the value picker to match the chosen property and Remake validates the resulting selection.

operations.label: Filter Characters by Ability Check
operations.summary: Runs an attribute or special-ability check over a bounded party set and stores the matching characters.
operations.reference: Candidate mode is party, alive, or selected; authors may retain successes or failures for later effects.
operations.example: var selected: int = await character_filter_ability("special", acrobatics, 30, "party", false)

operations.label: Change Shop Stock
operations.summary: Changes matching item quantities and optional inflation in an authored shop.
operations.reference: The effective shop is persisted even if its UI has not been opened yet; loaded shops update immediately.
operations.example: var slots: int = await inventory_change_shop(3, rope, -1, 0)

operations.label: Complete Campaign
operations.summary: Marks the current campaign complete and dispatches its one-time campaign-complete lifecycle hook.
operations.reference: Use only at an authored finale. Ordinary AP returns and battle victories do not complete a campaign; completion state is saved and repeated calls are idempotent.
